title: `SerializationFailure` when rotating push actions

labels.name: S-Major
labels.description: Major functionality / product severely impaired, no satisfactory workaround.

labels.name: T-Defect
labels.description: Bugs, crashes, hangs, security vulnerabilities, or other reported issues.

labels.name: X-Release-Blocker
labels.description: Must be resolved before making a release

labels.name: X-Regression
labels.description: Something broke which worked on a previous release

body:
We recently changed things so we rotate notifications almost immediately, rather than waiting a day. This interacts badly with people sending read receipts, as that transaction attempts to modify the push summary tables.

We need to fix this or revert before we make another release.

Broke by https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/pull/13005
